templates.name: 创建表
添加列
templates.template: ALTER TABLE table_name ADD COLUMN new_col VARCHAR(255);

templates.name: 修改列
templates.template: ALTER TABLE table_name ALTER COLUMN col1 TYPE VARCHAR(500);

templates.name: 删除列
templates.template: ALTER TABLE table_name DROP COLUMN col1;

templates.name: 删除表
templates.template: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS table_name;

templates.name: 清空表
templates.template: TRUNCATE TABLE table_name;

templates.name: 执行计划
templates.template: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE id = 1;

templates.name: 查询所有
templates.template: SELECT * FROM table_name LIMIT 100;

templates.name: 条件查询
templates.template: SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE id = 1;

templates.name: 分页查询
templates.template: SELECT * FROM table_name LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0;

templates.name: 排序查询
templates.template: SELECT * FROM table_name ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100;

templates.name: 去重查询
templates.template: SELECT DISTINCT col1 FROM table_name;

templates.name: 模糊查询
templates.template: SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE name LIKE '%keyword%';

templates.name: IN查询
templates.template: SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3);

templates.name: 范围查询
templates.template: SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 100;

templates.name: 关联查询
templates.template: SELECT t1.*, t2.name FROM table_name t1 LEFT JOIN other_table t2 ON t1.id = t2.id;

templates.name: 统计总数
templates.template: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM table_name;

templates.name: 条件统计
templates.template: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM table_name WHERE col1 = 'value';

templates.name: 分组统计
templates.template: SELECT col1, COUNT(*) as count FROM table_name GROUP BY col1;

templates.name: 最大值
templates.template: SELECT MAX(id) as max_id FROM table_name;

templates.name: 最小值
templates.template: SELECT MIN(id) as min_id FROM table_name;

templates.name: 平均值
templates.template: SELECT AVG(price) as avg_price FROM table_name;

templates.name: 求和
templates.template: SELECT SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM table_name;

templates.name: 插入数据
templates.template: INSERT INTO table_name (col1, col2) VALUES (val1, val2);

templates.name: 批量插入
templates.template: INSERT INTO table_name (col1, col2) VALUES (val1, val2), (val3, val4);

templates.name: 更新数据
templates.template: UPDATE table_name SET col1 = val1 WHERE id = 1;

templates.name: 批量更新
templates.template: UPDATE table_name SET col1 = val1, col2 = val2 WHERE id = 1;

templates.name: 删除数据
templates.template: DELETE FROM table_name WHERE id = 1;

templates.name: 条件删除
templates.template: DELETE FROM table_name WHERE col1 = 'value';

templates.name: 显示表
templates.template: SHOW TABLES;

templates.name: 表结构
templates.template: DESCRIBE table_name;

templates.name: 显示索引
templates.template: SHOW INDEX FROM table_name;
